import hashlib,json,pathlib,struct,sys
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
path=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else root/'reports/cc12_native_sound_state_writer_review.json'
receipt=json.loads(path.read_text());count=0;unique=set()
def walk(value):
 global count
 if isinstance(value,dict):
  retained=value.get('retained_path','').replace('\\','/')
  if retained.startswith('local/cc12_native_sound_state_writer_review/frozen/') and 'sha256' in value:
   data=(root/retained).read_bytes();assert len(data)==value['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==value['sha256'],value
   count+=1;unique.add(retained)
  for v in value.values():walk(v)
 elif isinstance(value,list):
  for v in value:walk(v)
walk(receipt)
def raw(pin):return (root/pin['retained_path']).read_bytes()
def load(pin):return json.loads(raw(pin))
for name,pin in receipt['complete_capture_pins'].items():
 value=load(pin)
 if name=='direct_references_capture.json':assert value==receipt['typed_live_query_batches'][0]
 if name=='ordinary_function_metadata_capture.json':assert value==receipt['typed_live_query_batches'][1]

 if name=='source_evidence_capture.json':assert value==receipt['complete_current_Source_Git_evidence']
for batch in receipt['typed_live_query_batches']:
 assert batch['program']=='/battlestationspacific.exe' and not batch['GPR_mutation']
 cfg=next(p for p in batch['implementation_and_config_pins'] if p['path'].endswith('target.json'))
 cfg=load(cfg);assert cfg['project']=='bsp' and cfg['project_file']=='C:/Users/sqz269/bsp.gpr' and cfg['program_path']=='/battlestationspacific.exe'
 assert cfg['language']=='x86:LE:32:default' and cfg['image_base']=='00400000'
 bsp=raw(next(p for p in batch['implementation_and_config_pins'] if p['path'].endswith('bsp.py'))).decode()
 verify=raw(next(p for p in batch['implementation_and_config_pins'] if p['path'].endswith('ghidra_export.py'))).decode()
 assert 'c.verify()' in bsp and "project['project_name'] != expected['project']" in verify
 for q in batch['commands']:
  assert q['exit_code']==0 and q['command'][2]=='ghidra' and q['environment_override']=={'BSP_GHIDRA_AUTOSTART':'0'}
  assert raw(q['stdout_pin']).decode()==q['stdout_text'] and raw(q['stderr_pin']).decode()==q['stderr_text']
source=receipt['complete_current_Source_Git_evidence'];files={}
for row in source['complete_selected_current_Source_Git_rows']:
 work=raw(row['working_pin']);git=raw(row['git_LF_preimage_pin']);lf=lambda b:b.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
 assert lf(work)==lf(git) and row['working_vs_git_LF_equal']

 if 'prior_NOSOUND_working_pin' in row:assert lf(work)==lf(raw(row['prior_NOSOUND_working_pin'])) and row['prior_NOSOUND_vs_current_LF_equal']
 files[row['path']]=work.decode()
